=2010=
== Status ==
The readers are lead (by the text) to think she is dead. Rand thinks she is dead. There is no supporting text for her survival; and finally after Rand balefired all of Natrin's Barrow, Ramshalan's compulsion disappears proving she was destroyed ([[TGS]], ch37). At least the status should be changed to "unknown". Having her status remain "ALIVE" is too misleading (unless you know something that we do not know and are determined to keep this your own secret) the status must be changed to something other than "ALIVE". I suggest her status be changed to "Unknown". [[User:Ronmamita|Ronmamita]] 09:59, September 24, 2010 (UTC)
:Going by precedent set from the last book release, information on the {{tl|Character}} template should be updated but the circumstances for those changes will be hidden by the {{tl|Spoiler}} template. So, right now, that information is correct. ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#000099;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 14:51, September 24, 2010 (UTC)
